model: the walk-hazard model of PREDICTIONS.json, J = 16, f = number of signed base points (assumed 2B; checked against the records)
metric: sum over paired workloads of residual_walk_step_transitions + residual_initial_step... i.e. trials (walk steps), fused / base, cluster bootstrap by workload
caveat: relations need several collisions plus direct hits; the model predicts the hazard ratio per step, which sets every collision time equally, so the ratio of total steps should follow it
